sentences.text:
1 In deference to the order dated 15.05.2023, Mr. Goswami, learned Junior Government Advocate,
Assam has obtained instructions from the Additional Deputy Commissioner, Dibrugarh.

As per letter bearing no. DRA.103/2017/301 dated 26.05.2023, the acquisition of land in respect of construction of no. 52[B] Trance Arunachal Pradesh Highway, the PWD [Roads], Assam is the requiring authority and the acquisition was done under Land Acquisition Act, 1894 [since repealed]
and the compensation was also determined under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 [since repealed].

Ms. Borah, learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that appropriate pleadings will be filed within a week's time seeking impleadment of PWD [Roads], Assam as a party-respondent in the instant writ petition.
List the case after 2 [two] weeks as prayed for by the learned counsel for the petitioners.
